description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About us&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</h2> <p>Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.&nbsp; Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.</p> <p>Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.&nbsp; Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.&nbsp; <br><br>In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. Your work will span across model architecture, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and real-world deployment. You’ll collaborate deeply with AI Platform, Simulation, Robot SW and Model Release teams to build systems that are performant, adaptable, and ready for production.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and improve end-to-end driving models with state-of-the-art performance, robustness, and generalization.</li> <li>Lead projects on personalized and collaborative driving, including behavior conditioning, comfort tuning, and user alignment.</li> <li>Build evaluation pipelines and metrics for both closed-loop and open-loop driving performance and product readiness.</li> <li>Curate and mine real-world and synthetic data to drive scenario diversity, coverage, and feature-specific development.</li> <li>Influence architecture choices, training methodologies, and deployment pathways for production-scale learning systems.</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally across various teams to ensure integration and iteration velocity.</li> <li>Mentor senior engineers and shape the long-term technical direction across Autonomy.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About You&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>In order to set you up for success as a Machine Learning Engineer at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Essential&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Extensive and proven track record of shipping deep learning systems to production.</li> <li>Expert in deep learning (esp. sequential models, control, planning, or perception).</li> <li>Proficient in Python and other relevant languages (e.g. C++ and CUDA) and ML frameworks (esp. PyTorch), with a solid foundation in software engineering practices.</li> <li>Experience with real-time systems or robotics, ideally with simulation- or vehicle-in-the-loop components.</li> <li>Ability to lead technical initiatives across teams, drive alignment, and mentor engineers.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Prior work in autonomous driving, imitation learning, or trajectory prediction.</li> <li>Familiarity with personalization, human behavior modeling, or driver intent inference.</li> <li>Experience integrating ML systems into production hardware or multi-agent simulation.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>This is a full-time role based in our office in Leonberg. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. Eigenständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Blick fürs große Ganze und fürs Detail. Erfahrung darin, komplexe Aufgaben zu strukturieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und mehrere Themen voranzubringen. Freude an Wissensaustausch, Mentoring und konstruktivem Feedback. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Visual und Interaction Design, nutzerzentrierten Methoden, Research und Figma. Fähigkeit, Designentscheidungen aus Nutzerbedürfnissen, qualitativen Erkenntnissen und quantitativen Daten abzuleiten. Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Engineering und Marketing. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Inhalte verständlich und überzeugend zu vermitteln. Erfahrung darin, Produktstrategien mitzugestalten. title: Growth Intern - Automation & AI (w/m/d)
description: Über uns Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser . In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement. Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur. Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG). Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance: Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer, ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität. Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt. Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus. Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS. Dein Profil Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2) , High-Growth Start-ups ( idealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement in Form von Praktika gesammelt Du studierst aktuell BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ein vergleichbares Feld und bringst eine ausgeprägte Affinität zu Technologie und KI mit Du hast bereits mit KI-Tools wie Claude, Claude Code und ChatGPT etc. gearbeitet oder brennst darauf, dich schnell einzuarbeiten Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend Deine Aufgaben Mission der Rolle Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Growth Konrad und unserem CEO Julius zusammen und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unseres AI-enabled Growth Set-ups. Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

  • ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und

  • digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Dein Profil

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg

  • Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten

  • Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst

  • Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase

  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend

Deine Aufgaben

Mission der Rolle

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Growth Konrad und unserem CEO Julius zusammen und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unseres AI-enabled Growth Set-ups.

Dein Ziel: Unsere Projektleiter:innen bei der Umsetzung unterstützen, interne Prozesse weiterentwickeln und datenbasierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen. Dabei wirst du ein tiefes Verständnis für Energieprojekte, Operations und Business-Aufbau entwickeln.

1. Prozessanalyse & Priorisierung

  • Du screenst gemeinsam mit den Teams (u. a. Sales, Partnerships, CEO Office) bestehende Abläufe und identifizierst, wo manuelle Arbeit am meisten Zeit kostet

  • Du bewertest Automatisierungspotenzial nach Aufwand vs. Impact und leitest daraus eine klare Priorisierung ab

  • Du hältst Anforderungen und Prozesslogik so fest, dass daraus direkt eine Lösung gebaut werden kann

2. Technische Umsetzung

  • Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Komplexität sowie Optimierungspotenziale

  • Du hilfst dabei, Entscheidungsprozesse zu strukturieren und Automatisierungen operativ sauber aufzusetzen

  • Du unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer technologischer Strukturen, Standards und Templates für operative Projekte

3. Prozessoptimierung & interne Strukturen

  • Du entwickelst interne Prozesse und Tools (z. B. in Airtable) weiter, um operative Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit zu erhöhen

  • Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in bestehenden Abläufen und setzt konkrete Optimierungen, z.B. mittels Automatisierungen (Claude), um

  • Du übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Special Projects in den Bereichen Organisation, Tooling und interne Strukturen

Benefits

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt

Startdatum: so bald wie möglich

Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket

Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Analytics & Characterization: You are the analytical core of our lab. Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run. Your profile Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority. Analytical Expertise: Strong practical experience in general instrumental and wet-chemical analytics (especially NMR, IR, DSC, titration). Experience in specialized polymer testing (e.g., MFR/MFI, tensile testing) or prior experience in a plastics laboratory is a major plus! Synthesis Experience: Experience in carrying out organic syntheses safely according to protocol (SOPs). Specialized knowledge of polymers or reactors is advantageous, but not mandatory—we are happy to train you. Technical Routine: You feel "at home" in the lab. Team Culture: Join a team of curious minds that challenge each other, collaborate openly and celebrate progress together. title: Staff Data Engineer
description: We're seeking a Staff Data Engineer to join one of the fastest-growing AI legal tech companies in Europe. You'll take technical ownership of the data platform behind how we run the business: the pipelines, the warehouse, and the definitions behind the numbers our leadership team actually uses. You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work alongside a colleague who owns the business-facing side of data, plus our infrastructure and application engineers. This is a senior individual contributor role with no line management in either direction, roughly 70% hands-on building, 30% defining, documenting and explaining. Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role JUPUS supports hundreds of law firms across Europe, and our customer base is growing roughly 4x a year. Our data platform has grown with it (ClickHouse, dbt, Python extract-load pipelines into an S3 data lake, orchestration in GitHub Actions) and it has grown fast. Your job is to make it trustworthy. That means modernising what already exists, making historical trends a record of what actually happened rather than a nightly re-derivation of it, and owning the definitions behind the metrics that reach our board. This is not a greenfield build, and it is not a maintenance seat. It is a real platform with real problems, and you would own it. Tasks Own the data platform end to end: ingestion and the raw layer, the ClickHouse warehouse, and the dbt project on top of it. You're the person who can say whether a number is wrong or the pipeline is. Make our numbers trustworthy: reliability, correctness, and a history that holds up, so that a trend is a record of what actually happened rather than a re-derivation of it. Own the metrics the company runs on , starting with our customer health score- the definition, the denominator, the eligibility rules and the known limitations, not just the SQL underneath them. Turn business questions into durable metrics: work directly with Customer Success, Sales, Product and leadership to understand what they're actually trying to decide, then build something defensible enough to decide on. Keep cost and complexity in check as we grow: warehouse architecture, query cost, and the surfaces that deliver data into BI and our CRM. All of it gets harder as the customer base multiplies. Set the standard for how data work is done here: one authoritative written definition per leadership-visible number, and the conventions that inform our Data function as it grows with us. Requirements Technical Expertise Substantial experience in data engineering or analytics engineering , with production ownership of a warehouse and a transformation layer. We care more about evidence of ownership than about years served. ClickHouse in production. dbt at ownership level: incremental models, snapshots, tests, macros, CI/CD. Ideally you've inherited someone else's dbt project and left it better than you found it. Python data engineering: EL tooling, S3, CI-based orchestration that you’ve owned end to end, with no platform team behind you. Product event streams: PostHog, Amplitude, Segment, Mixpanel or similar. You understand how user-to-company identity and group association break, and what that does to every metric downstream. Judgement and Ownership You have defined a business KPI end to end and defended it to non-technical people. This is the differentiator for us. An excellent engineer who takes requirements as given is not the right fit for this role. Analytical rigour: cohorts, correct denominators, sample size stated before findings. You'll say "we can't tell yet, and here's exactly why" rather than produce a confident chart. You act without waiting for a ticket , and you can name something you chose to stop doing. You're comfortable in front of senior stakeholders , including C-level, and can hold a technical line without losing the room. Further Requirements Located within CET +/-2 . Nice to have: BI tool administration (we use Metabase), CRM and billing systems as data sources, dlt specifically, GDPR-driven data deletion work, Grafana, German, or B2B SaaS and legal-tech domain experience. Nice to have: you're used to non-technical colleagues querying data through AI tools, and you design for that. Benefits 🎯 Metric Ownership – Own a business-critical metric end to end, definition included — not just the pipeline that feeds it. 🛠️ A Real Platform – ClickHouse and dbt already in production, with genuine problems worth solving. No greenfield theatre, no maintenance seat. ⚡ Direct Access – A flat structure and a direct line to our Head of Engineering, CTO and CEO. No committee between you and a decision. 📈 Growth Stage – Roughly 4x customer growth a year at one of Europe's fastest-growing AI legal tech companies. 🏡 Fully Remote – Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere 💻 Top Equipment – State-of-the-art MacBook plus all the accessories you need 🏋️ Wellbeing Perks – Urban Sports Club membership to support your healthy lifestyle If you're excited about owning the numbers an AI startup runs on and delivering the data that guides us in our scaling journey, we'd love to hear from you. raw.title: Customer Success Manager, DACH
raw.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager at Heidi Health, you’ll be the bridge between technology and care - helping hospitals, clinics, and clinicians across Germany adopt and love Heidi.

You’ll manage the full customer journey for both public and private hospital deployments, ensuring seamless implementation, strong clinician engagement, and measurable impact on patient care.


This role is ideal for someone with a medical background (e.g. former doctor, nurse, or allied health professional) who’s excited to drive digital transformation in healthcare.

What you’ll do

  • Own customer outcomes: Be the strategic partner for a portfolio of Heidi’s customers, ensuring they achieve measurable success and realise value.

  • Lead onboarding & training: Lead onboarding of new customers from planning, training through to go-live, delivering seamless integrations into customer workflows.

  • Track and improve metrics along customer journey like time-to-first-value and early activation.

  • Drive strategic adoption: Develop and execute tailored adoption plans to maximise user engagement and satisfaction, enhancing the continued love for Heidi among clinicians.

  • Enhance Retention & Growth: Identify expansion opportunities, mitigate churn risks and work cross-functionally to deepen product engagement.

  • Customer advocacy: Build executive-level relationships and become the voice of the customer internally, advocating for their needs and priorities and showcasing wins.

  • Continuous engagement: Deliver value at every touchpoint through proactive check-ins, success planning, and education strategies. Think and act strategically to scale your impact.

  • Resolve operational blockers: Collaborate with product, engineering, and support teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.

  • Feedback insights: Gather and share insights to influence product development and feature prioritisation.

What you'll need

  • 2+ years in a customer success role at a SaaS company, with proven ability to own the full lifecycle

  • A romantic streak about software. You believe great products can transform someone's day.

  • Familiarity with Germany’s healthcare ecosystem (both public and private).

  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effortlessly set and manage expectations with customers and cross-functional teams.

  • Highly organised and can confidently manage multiple projects and competing priorities, while maintaining attention to detail and quality.

  • Self-starter with a bias for action, comfortable navigating fast-paced and ambiguous environments.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Attitude is more important than experience - if you are hungry, competitive, and motivated, with a knack for problem solving and relationship-building, we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.


We take care of you.

title: Werkstudent Go-To-Market & Partner Management (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen. Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde. Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben. Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen. Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch. Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender. Konkret: ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt. DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden. ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste Rückmeldung, die wir zum Produkt bekommen. Du bist die direkteste Leitung dorthin und nutzt sie. BEZIEHUNG STATT KONTAKTLISTE: Du übernimmst einen festen Kreis von Partnern. Nach drei Monaten kennen die deinen Namen, nicht unsere Rufnummer. SAUBER NACHHALTEN: Was besprochen wurde, landet nachvollziehbar in Hubspot, damit das Team damit weiterarbeiten kann. Dein Talent SUSTAINABILITY: Du interessierst dich sehr für Klimaschutz und Nachhaltigkeit und willst mehr darüber lernen und bewegen WORKING STUDENT: Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium und bringst idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen mit, zum Beispiel durch Praktika oder ehrenamtliches Engagement AM TELEFON ZU HAUSE: Du hast schon mal jemanden am Telefon von etwas überzeugt — im Job, im Verein, im Nebenjob, egal. AUF DEN PUNKT, OHNE KALT ZU WIRKEN: Du sagst in drei Sätzen, wofür andere zehn brauchen, und klingst dabei trotzdem wie ein Mensch. Handwerksbetriebe haben keine Zeit für Marketing-Sprache und merken sofort, wenn jemand welche spricht. ZUVERLÄSSIG, NICHT VERHANDELBAR: Zugesagter Rückruf am Donnerstag heißt Donnerstag. Das ist bei uns Grundvoraussetzung, keine Stärke. DU BRINGST WAS ZURÜCK: Nach fünfzig Gesprächen hast du eine Meinung dazu, was funktioniert. Du sagst sie, ohne dass wir danach fragen müssen. DEUTSCH AUF MUTTERSPRACHNIVEAU: Unsere Partner sind deutsche Handwerksbetriebe. Das Gespräch läuft auf Deutsch, inklusive Zwischentöne und Dialekt am anderen Ende. MINDESTENS 6 MONATE ZEIT: Kürzer lohnt sich für keinen von uns beiden. Bis du richtig gut in diesen Gesprächen bist, vergehen Wochen. Unser Angebot Wachstum & Kultur Werde Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur fachlich durchstartet, sondern aktiv eine gesunde und nachhaltige Unternehmenskultur lebt. Bei uns zählt das Miteinander genauso viel wie der Erfolg. Impact & Awareness Deine Stimme hat Gewicht, im Büro und darüber hinaus. Neben deinem regulären Urlaub bekommst du zusätzliche freie Tage für Klimaaktivismus, Demos oder Projekte, die dir am Herzen liegen. Flexibilität & Vertrauen Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinem Rhythmus. Nutze unsere Flexdays, um mobil zu arbeiten – egal ob von zu Hause oder unterwegs innerhalb Deutschlands, immer in Absprache mit deinem Team. Extra Benefits für dich Wir machen deinen Alltag einfacher: Du bekommst einen flexiblen Bonus, den du nach Lust und Laune für Dinge einsetzen kannst, die dir Freude machen – ob Fitness, Kultur oder kleine Extras. Verpflegung & Wohlbefinden Wenn der Arbeitstag mal länger wird, sorgen wir dafür, dass niemand hungrig bleibt. Bestell dir über Wolt eine Mahlzeit direkt ins Büro – easy und lecker. Community & Spirit Wir verändern die Welt – und verlieren dabei nie den Spaß. Freu dich auf regelmäßige Offsites, Teamabende und unser legendäres „Bees & Beers“ als perfekten Ausgleich zu unserer Mission. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Wir bauen kein Unternehmen über Headcount auf. Unsere Teams bestehen aus erfahrenen Expert:innen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem klaren Anspruch an Qualität und Geschwindigkeit. Top-Profil: Sehr starker akademischer Track Record und typischerweise 3–8 Jahre relevante Erfahrung – z. B. Strategy Consulting + Operator-Rolle, Founders' Office oder General Management. Business-relevante Projekte: Neue Geschäftsmodelle, Partnerschaften, Marketing Channels, regulatorische Themen, Markterweiterungen und andere strategische Initiativen. Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau ist aufgrund unseres regulierten Steuerumfelds zwingend erforderlich. Starkes Gehalt + VSOP , ein klarer Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta (wenn dein Weg dich stattdessen zur eigenen Gründung führt, unterstützen wir dich gerne mit einem Angel-Ticket). Du bist für relevante strategische Themen von der ersten Idee bis zum messbaren Business Impact verantwortlich. Achtung: Das ist keine klassische Stabs-, PMO- oder Koordinationsrolle. Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, schaffst Struktur, entwickelst Business Cases, identifizierst und verhandelst mit Partner:innen und treibst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit Product, Tech, Marketing und Operations bis zum Go-live. Du übernimmst Ownership, schaffst Klarheit und bringst die Lösung ins Ziel. Exzellentes Deutsch ist zwingend erforderlich Du sprichst Deutsch auf nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte sprachlich präzise erfassen, formulieren und verhandeln. Was wir dir bieten: starkes Gehalt + VSOP direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CEO und Management Team außergewöhnlich viel Verantwortung und Entscheidungsspielraum kurze Wege von einer guten Idee zur tatsächlichen Umsetzung einen bewussten Entwicklungspfad in eine operative Leadership-Rolle bei Zasta Wir suchen keinen Career Chief of Staff. Im besten Fall übernimmst du nach dieser Rolle einen relevanten Teil des Unternehmens selbst – als Business Owner, VP oder in einer anderen Leadership-Funktion. description: Business Systems, Digitalisierung & KI Du verstehst Softwareentwicklung, denkst in Geschäftsprozessen und bringst komplexe Projekte in die Umsetzung? Dann unterstütze mit uns wachsende Unternehmen dabei, ihre Systeme, Daten und Abläufe zukunftsfähig aufzustellen. Du bist arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Fachabteilungen und technischen Verantwortlichen unserer Kunden zusammen. Unser Beratungs- und Engineering-Team unterstützt dich mit fachlichem Sparring und Entwicklungskompetenz. Aufgaben Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für Digitalisierungs- und Softwareprojekte – von der ersten Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur Einführung. Dabei verbindest du technische Tiefe mit wirtschaftlichem Denken und verlässlicher Projektsteuerung. Anforderungen klären: Du analysierst Prozesse, Systeme und Datenflüsse und führst die Bedürfnisse verschiedener Fachbereiche zusammen. Lösungen bewerten: Du vergleichst Standardsoftware, Integrationen und Eigenentwicklung hinsichtlich Nutzen, Kosten, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit. Umsetzung steuern: Du entwickelst priorisierte Roadmaps, definierst Arbeitspakete und koordinierst Beteiligte, Abhängigkeiten und Entscheidungen. Ergebnisse sichern: Du begleitest Einführung und Abnahme, dokumentierst Wissen und bereitest die Übergabe an interne Teams vor. KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du erkennst Potenziale für Automatisierung und berücksichtigst dabei Qualität, Datenschutz und Sicherheit. Qualifikation Mehrjährige Erfahrung in technischer Projektleitung, IT-Beratung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit eigenständig verantworteten Software- oder Integrationsprojekten. Eigene Softwareentwicklungserfahrung und fundiertes Verständnis für Datenmodelle, APIs, Architektur und nachhaltigen Softwarebetrieb. Starke Analysefähigkeiten: Du übersetzt unklare Anforderungen in verständliche Prozesse, nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen und umsetzbare Schritte. Verständnis für Unternehmenssoftware , insbesondere für das Zusammenspiel von CRM, Backoffice, Kundenservice und Reporting. Wirtschaftliches Urteilsvermögen: Du priorisierst nach Nutzen, Aufwand und Risiken und kannst Eigenentwicklung gegen Zukauf abwägen. Selbstständigkeit und Verbindlichkeit: Du beschaffst fehlende Informationen, hältst offene Themen nach und schaffst Orientierung bei wechselnden Anforderungen. Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch mit Geschäftsführung, Fachbereichen und Entwicklern sowie Praxisverständnis für KI und Automatisierung. Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Erfahrungen mit wachsenden Unternehmen, CRM-/ERP-Einführungen, Unternehmensgruppen, KI-gestützter Entwicklung oder Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n, Make und Zapier. Benefits Du erhältst eigenständige Projektverantwortung, direkten Austausch mit Entscheidern und fachliche Unterstützung durch unser Team. Du gestaltest technische Lösungen mit und begleitest ihre Einführung in den Arbeitsalltag unserer Kunden. Entscheidend sind für uns deine nachweisbaren Projektergebnisse und dein technisches Urteilsvermögen. Einen bestimmten Abschluss, eine Zertifizierung oder einen festen Technologie-Stack setzen wir nicht voraus. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein bis zwei kurze Projektbeispiele: Welche Herausforderung hast du übernommen, welche Verantwortung hattest du und was wurde erreicht? description: Our Mission At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. Onboarding & Offboarding: Own the operational employee lifecycle. Prepare contracts and documents, coordinate equipment and accounts, run structured first days, and manage clean offboardings. Personio: Keep our HR system the single source of truth. Maintain employee data, absences, digital personnel files, and documentation quality, and help us get more out of the tool than we do today. Recruiting Support: Draft and publish job ads, keep our applicant tracking system clean, coordinate interview scheduling, and own candidate communication so no application goes unanswered. Recruiting Day: Organize our candidate day end to end: invitations, agenda, materials, interviewer briefings, and on site coordination. title: Principal Product Manager (Airlines / Travel / Consulting)
description: <div> <div class="description content"> <p>The most impactful digital products in the market today are the direct result of a seamless blend of business strategy, design and technology. Orchestrating this behind-the-scenes integration is a Product Manager, who prioritizes the customer experience from vision to execution and, together with their team, guides all workstreams toward a common vision and plan for delivery.</p> <p>We’re looking for a seasoned product leader with a background in <strong>Airlines / Travel and Consulting </strong>to join the Customer Experience, Product and Design (CXPD) service line.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li>As a trusted advisor to our client’s leadership, you will partner with them to understand their context and needs, make recommendations, and provide advice and hands-on expertise on taking new products from concept to market to scale.</li> <li>Drive the innovation mindset and the overall product development lifecycle, utilising lean and hypothesis driven approaches to identify, conceptualise and pilot new products that deliver undeniable value.&nbsp;</li> <li>Establish the market &amp; competitive landscape, go to market strategy and business case or economic model for the opportunity with our clients.&nbsp;</li> <li>Lead the stakeholders to think about customer’s problems, business outcomes and take them on the change journey of moving to empowered product teams that create strategic growth for the organisation.</li> <li>Shape and lead teams to deliver client engagements in a way which is both effective for our client and operationally sound for Thoughtworks.</li> <li>Help shape CXPD service line value propositions, creating case studies, points of view and other content through insights on client needs and solutions, and also through defining repeatable practices which will help us to scale our efforts.</li> <li>Get involved in pre-sales, creating proposals and pitches, shaping engagements for clients and helping to educate both clients and colleagues about the value of our services.</li> <li>Contribute to the growth and scale of our evolving business through taking an active part in recruiting, community building, mentorship and driving continuous improvement in practices and techniques.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in leading new ideas from concept to launch and scale with expertise in go-to-market strategy and developing new revenue streams.</li> <li>Experience in commercial and economic modelling, including monetisation strategy.</li> <li>Experience in bringing an innovation mindset into an organisation at scale and creating sustained innovation investment across strategic horizons.</li> <li>Depth in conducting research and bringing market trends, customer and competitive insights to facilitate strategic ideation to identify opportunities for strategic growth.</li> <li>Depth and expertise in developing value proposition, using lean approaches to test viability, feasibility and desirable to achieve problem-solution and product-market fit before scaling.</li> <li>Demonstrated hypothesis and data driven problem-solving orientation with exceptional ability to create structured quantitative and qualitative analyses.</li> <li>Operate at company, portfolio and product level — defining and executing a strategy, shaping a vision and translating it into a roadmap with clear business and customer value-based measures of success.</li> <li>Advise clients on becoming a value-driven, customer-centric product organisation and drive the change by introducing best practices in product management, value delivery and measurement and making innovation mainstream.</li> <li>Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Skilled at operating and building relationships with C-suite executives and confident in driving conversations at the intersection of technology and business.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills — active listening, persuading and empathising with others and excellent written and verbal communication.</li> <li>Ability to formulate and deliver insights around complex business problems in a thoughtful and persuasive manner.</li> <li>Strong consulting skills and can operate with ambiguity.</li> <li>Bias for action, and can break down complex problems into tangible steps.</li> <li>Enjoy collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and can operate as an advisory but also as a hands on practitioner.</li> <li>Passionate about creating thought-leadership and representing our brand and value proposition in external events, and by writing articles or white papers.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning &amp; Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Onsite</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Field Account Executive
description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! Lightspeed is looking for a motivated and collaborative Field Sales Account Executive to join our growing EMEA Hospitality team. Based in London, you’ll play a key role in building strong relationships across your region, supporting hospitality businesses in finding the right solutions, and guiding them through their entire journey with Lightspeed - from first conversations to long-term partnerships. Our Hospitality team is expanding to meet growing demand. After refining our approach at a smaller scale, we’re now excited to grow our team and extend our impact. What you'll be doing: Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the London hospitality industry to spot trends and opportunities. Leverage market research and insights to shape effective territory sales plans. Engage prospects through high-velocity in-person meetings, outreach, and tailored presentations to convert them into loyal customers. Lead your territory with an entrepreneurial mindset, delivering consistent revenue growth. Guide clients from needs analysis and solution design through proposals, contract agreements, and seamless onboarding. Deliver engaging presentations showcasing Lightspeed’s POS and hospitality technology suite. Keep Salesforce data precise and current to streamline reporting and forecasting. Drive outbound initiatives and attend industry events to expand qualified leads. Provide customer feedback to sales and marketing teams to refine strategies and achieve collective targets. And a little bit of.... Contribute as an integral part of the wider team to achieve organisational goals, even if this means undertaking tasks outside the strict scope of your primary role. What you need to bring: Proven Field Sales and Outbound Sales experience, ideally within technology, SaaS, or hospitality sales. Deep understanding of the hospitality industry, including different segments (restaurants, cafés, bars, hotels) and their unique needs. Solid grasp of sales development best practices: pipeline building, territory planning, lead generation, and new business development. Strong time management and organisational skills - you know how to prioritise and plan your week effectively. Excellent customer service, communication, and presentation skills A track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets (monthly, quarterly, and annual), contributing directly to regional growth goals. Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM or a similar system to manage leads, opportunities, and sales pipelines. Comfortable using data to make informed decisions - you take a data-driven approach to sales performance. Highly motivated, competitive, and confident in a quota-driven environment. Entrepreneurial and adaptable mindset - proactive, agile, and quick to adjust to evolving business goals. What's in it for you? Come live the Lightspeed Experience… Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story … and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy and healthy: Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners) Flexible Paid Time Off - providing you the freedom to take time off however you like Private Medical Insurance and cash health plan for optical, dental and more. Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 GBP per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health Mental Health Support through the LifeWorks and Modern Health Apps- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow Time off to volunteer and give back to your community Transit benefit - if you travel by public transport to our London offices A variety of drinks & snacks in our offices in London To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement . Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, CRM Marketing, Europe
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About Crunchyroll</h2> <p>Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.</p> <p>Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>Crunchyroll is seeking a Senior Manager, CRM Marketing to lead localized CRM engagement for our European markets, one of our fastest-growing regions. Based in London, this role will own the CRM campaign calendar for the region, balancing high-velocity title moments and catalog beats while bringing our biggest anime moments to life across owned channels.</p> <p>You will plan and execute high-impact, fan-first campaigns that support title launches and catalog discovery—including new season/series drops, dub drops, mid-season arcs, and finales for top-tier titles. Success in this role requires strong segmentation and analytical judgment, plus the ability to translate IP into messaging that creates an emotional connection with fans.</p> <p>You’ll also act as a subject matter expert for the Europe market, championing transcreation and locally resonant storytelling (not just translation), cultural nuance, and fan-first engagement. You’ll partner closely with our global Lifecycle Marketing team that owns always-on lifecycle journeys; in this role, you will serve as a regional advisor and ensure key title moments and local insights are reflected in the broader lifecycle strategy.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>CRM Campaign Calendar Ownership: </strong>Own the CRM campaign calendar for Europe across tentpole releases, seasonal beats, and catalog programming, aligning timing, targeting strategy, and channel plans with local and global priorities (across multiple markets, languages, and time zones).<strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Go-to-Market Campaigns:</strong> Collaborate with regional marketing, brand, programming, and curation teams to design localized go-to-market moments for major content launches, seasonal events, partnerships, and fan activations.</li> <li><strong>Segmentation &amp; Audience Strategy:</strong> Apply best practices in personalization and segmentation to build targeted campaigns informed by fan behavior, affinities, regional nuances, and language/dub preferences. Partner with Data Science and Growth teams to refine audience definitions, identify opportunities, and improve precision over time.</li> <li><strong>Regional Market Expertise:</strong> Serve as Crunchyroll’s CRM market lead for Europe, advising on cultural nuances, local market behaviors, local platform norms, channel norms, and fan engagement opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Localized Lifecycle Strategy:</strong> Provide regional inputs into Europe lifecycle journey strategies across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and winback, working closely with our Lifecycle Marketing team. Ensure best practices in personalization, segmentation, and lifecycle orchestration.</li> <li><strong>Marketing Technology Ownership:</strong> Lead campaign execution and performance optimization in partnership with Operations, Martech, and Data Analytics; manage CRM initiatives within Braze (or similar) across email, push, in-app, notification center, and relevant messaging channels, ensuring excellence in configuration, QA, measurement, and reporting. Own content-triggered messaging strategy that supports title moments and engagement in alignment with lifecycle standards and guardrails.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Partnership:</strong> Work with Regional Marketing, Product, Brand, Content, Creative, Data Science, and GTM teams to create cohesive fan experiences and ensure lifecycle campaigns align with both local and global priorities.</li> <li><strong>Performance &amp; Optimization:</strong> Analyze CRM campaign performance, identify opportunities, and apply insights to continuously improve effectiveness and fan impact through test-and-learn approaches, including cohort analysis and incrementality-minded measurement.</li> <li><strong>Innovation &amp; Experimentation:</strong> Stay ahead of market dynamics and messaging ecosystems (multilingual markets, consent and preference management, deliverability best practices, local payment behaviors, and evolving platform changes across iOS/Android) to evolve CRM campaign strategy and execution.</li> </ul> <h2>About You</h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in CRM, retention, or subscriber engagement marketing, ideally within streaming, digital subscription, gaming, e-commerce, or entertainment.</li> <li>Strong experience with Braze (or comparable orchestration platforms) with a focus on campaign planning/execution, segmentation, triggers, and multi-channel delivery.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of European consumer behaviors, digital marketing platforms, and messaging ecosystems (including WhatsApp where applicable), with experience operating in privacy-first environments.</li> <li>Strong creative acumen and storytelling ability—capable of translating IP into fan-first messaging that builds emotional connection and drives action.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills to interpret performance data, develop insights, and translate them into targeting and creative optimizations.</li> <li>Proven ability to collaborate across regional and global teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.</li> <li>Passion for anime, entertainment, or fan-first brands is highly valued.&nbsp;</li> <li>Additional proficiency in relevant regional languages is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>The Lifecycle Marketing team curates personalized journeys that strengthen fan loyalty and lifetime value. With data-driven insights and fan-first creativity, we connect users to the right experiences at the right moments across owned channels.</p> <h2>Why you will love working at Crunchyroll</h2> <p>In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:</p> <ul> <li>Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage</li> <li>Access to counseling &amp; mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> <li>Employer 5% salary contribution into a DC Pension Plan</li> <li>Allowances for Gym &amp; Wellness, Meals, Commuting</li> <li>Free premium access to Crunchyroll along with monthly discounts to the Crunchyroll store</li> <li>Professional Development</li> <li>Company's Paid Parental Leave <ul> <li>up to 22 weeks for birthing parents</li> <li>up to 12 weeks for non-birthing parents</li> </ul> </li> <li>Hybrid Work Schedule</li> <li>Paid Time Off <ul> <li>Flex Time Off</li> <li>5 Yasumi Days</li> <li>Half-Day Fridays during the summer</li> <li>Winter Break</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About our Values</h3> <p>We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value</p> <ul> <li> <p>Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.</p> </li> <li> <p>Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.</p> </li> <li>Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.</li> <li> <p>Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Our commitment to diversity and inclusion</h3> <p>Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity &amp; inclusion. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</p> <p>Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Questions about Crunchyroll’s hiring process? Please check out our Hiring FAQs:&nbsp;</em><em data-stringify-type="italic"><a href="https://help.crunchyroll.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040471712-Crunchyroll-Hiring-FAQs">https://help.crunchyroll.com/hc/en-us/articles/360040471712-Crunchyroll-Hiring-FAQs</a></em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Please refer to our&nbsp;Candidate Privacy Policy for more information about how we process your personal information, and your data protection rights: <a href="https://tbcdn.talentbrew.com/company/22978/v1_0/docs/spe-jobs-privacy-policy-update-for-crpa-dec-21-22.pdf">https://tbcdn.talentbrew.com/company/22978/v1_0/docs/spe-jobs-privacy-policy-update-for-crpa-dec-21-22.pdf</a></em></p> <p>Please beware of recent scams to online job seekers.   • Build proactive working relationships across the wider business, keeping key stakeholders informed and aligned

  • Agentic approach to complex, multi-step content challenges — from brief through to live publication

Why Deliveroo?

We're building the definitive online food company, transforming the way the world eats by making hyper-local food more convenient and accessible. We obsess about building the future of food, whilst using our network as a force for good. We're at the forefront of an industry, powered by our market-leading technology and unrivalled network to bring incredible convenience and selection to our customers.

Working at Deliveroo is the perfect environment to build a definitive career, motivated by impact. Firstly, the impact that working here will have on your development, allowing you to grow faster than you might elsewhere; secondly, the impact that you can have on Deliveroo, leaving your mark as we scale; and finally, being part of something bigger, through the impact that we make together in our marketplace and communities.


What you'll do?

As a Software Engineer at Deliveroo, your individual work contributes to achieving goals in and across your team. While you will work with your team and you may lead projects, some of your work will contribute outside of your direct remit. You will report to managers and group leads and together deliver the results.

Technical Execution:

  • You will improve code structure, have an impact on architecture, and review code of any scope produced by your team.

  • You'll aim to simplify the maintenance and operation of production systems, visibility, operational readiness, and health of your team's systems.

Collaboration & Leadership:

  • As well as leading from the front regarding technical execution, you'll build relationships with other engineering teams and, identify collaboration opportunities.

  • You'll own larger pieces of work, assist with design and technical / implementation choices and influence the roadmap within your team.

  • You will take an active role in the hiring process and conducting engineering interviews. This will also extend to the current team where you will support the personal growth of colleagues, encouraging efficiency in their roles.

We want to emphasise that we don't expect you to meet all of the below but would love you to have experience in some of these areas.

  • Pride in readable, well-designed, well-tested software

  • Experience writing web-based applications in any language, and an interest in learning (Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, or Rust)

  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)

  • Experience with web architecture at scale (20krpm and above)

You'll be on the front lines, working directly with a handful of complex clients to understand their unique needs, integrate LILT's platform into their existing workflows, troubleshoot technical challenges, and provide expert guidance. This role requires a strong technical foundation, business acumen, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and a passion for customer success. You will thrive in a dynamic environment, embracing the opportunity to travel and work collaboratively with diverse teams. On-Site Engineering: Ability to gather requirements, propose a product solution, and implement it via code on-site with customers. On-site Support and Training: Provide on-site technical support and training to client teams, ensuring successful adoption and utilization of the LILT platform. Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for escalated client issues, diagnosing problems, implementing solutions, and ensuring timely resolution. Technical Consultation and Best Practices: Provide expert technical consultation and guidance to clients on how to best leverage LILT's features and capabilities within their environment, focused on addressing complex, enterprise workflows. Feedback Loop: Act as a crucial feedback channel, relaying client needs, technical challenges, and product improvement suggestions back to the core Engineering and Product teams. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including integration guides, best practices, and troubleshooting steps. Contribute to internal knowledge sharing initiatives. Travel: Be willing and able to travel frequently (up to 25-35%) to client sites globally. Strong AI knowledge including an: Understanding of how LLMs are trained and how inference works Understanding of batch learning, on-line learning and context windows and how to use them to improve customer value Understanding of the trade-offs of inference speed, learnings, model sizes and costs Current knowledge of best-in-class AI tools for a variety of workflows including adoption processes and requirements Understanding or demonstrated experiencing using MCP to build agentic workflows Strong business acumen and the ability to leverage this skillset to focus customers on accomplishing business outcomes aligned to their growth and efficiency objectives. Strong understanding of software integration principles and experience working with APIs (RESTful, SOAP). Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, JavaScript). Experience with enterprise software deployments and integrations. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues. Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong customer-centric mindset with a passion for ensuring client success. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience with translation management systems (TMS) or localization workflows is a plus. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus. Fluency in multiple languages is a plus. What We Offer: Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry. A dynamic and collaborative work environment. Significant opportunities for professional growth and development. The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business. Our Story Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born. LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI. With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning. At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer within our Maritime domain, you will lead the backend architecture and streaming services that process high-volume vessel tracking, port intelligence, and maritime trade flows. Working with core technologies including Python, PHP, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse, you will design scalable, highly available systems that transform raw maritime telemetry into real-time actionable insights for global shipping and commodity markets. Operating with high autonomy under a "you build it, you run it" engineering culture, you will play a crucial role in modernizing core services, elevating technical standards, and collaborating with cross-functional partners and client-facing technical teams.


Key Responsibilities

 

  • Architect and scale backend services: Design, build, and maintain high-throughput backend applications and microservices using Python and PHP.

  • Build real-time streaming & analytical pipelines: Leverage Kafka and ClickHouse to stream, process, and analyze massive volumes of real-time maritime tracking data.

  • Optimize data persistence and storage: Manage relational and analytical databases, optimizing PostgreSQL queries and ClickHouse schema designs for low-latency queries at scale.

  • Own production health and reliability: Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and observability frameworks while maintaining operational ownership across staging and production environments.

  • Drive cross-functional collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Tech Leads, Cloud Platform teams, and client-facing technical teams to deliver features aligned with customer needs.

  • Elevate engineering standards and mentorship: Guide peer engineers through technical design reviews, code quality benchmarks, and architectural best practices within the Maritime domain.


Experience & Background
What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • Senior-level backend experience: ~5+ years of professional software engineering experience developing, scaling, and maintaining complex production backend systems.

  • Core tech stack mastery: Strong proficiency in Python and PHP alongside deep experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL.

  • Event streaming & analytical data tech: Hands-on production experience with Apache Kafka and high-performance analytical data stores like ClickHouse.

  • System design & API development: Proven track record designing RESTful APIs, distributed microservices, and high-concurrency architecture.

  • Operational mindset: Strong background in CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), and production observability/monitoring tools.

    • Nice-to-haves

    • Maritime & geospatial domain knowledge: Familiarity with vessel AIS data, geospatial systems, logistics, or global trade datasets.

    • Legacy modernization: Track record of refactoring monolithic architectures into event-driven, decoupled microservices.

    • Cloud infrastructure: Experience with AWS cloud services and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. Harvey's law school program has reached 50+ US schools in year one. Now we are taking it global, and we need the right person to lead that charge expanding in the EMEA, and APAC markets.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France

This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one.

What you will do

  • Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France.

  • Open doors with provider groups, EHR vendors, system integrators, payors, and commercial resellers to accelerate Tandem’s reach and adoption.

  • Pitch, negotiate, and close deals that deliver strategic value, working closely with legal, product, and commercial teams to get contracts across the line.

  • Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.

  • Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.

  • Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem

  • A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.

  • Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.

  • A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.

  • Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.

  • Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.

  • Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.

  • Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare

  • Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.


What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Paid parental leave

  • €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

  • A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

  • Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

  • Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

  • State of the art office in the heart of Paris, and your choice of IT equipment

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.


How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with our Country Director in France

  3. Working Day - Join us in the Paris office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

title: Finance Business Partner
description: About Everfield Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem. Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing. About the Role This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses. You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound. Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies. What You'll Do Own the numbers • Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation. • Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements. • Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance. • Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report. • Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations. • Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO. Drive the growth agenda • Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them. • Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business. • Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent. • Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control. • Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI. • Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region. Who We're Looking For • An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business. • Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output. • Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it. • A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent). • 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering. • Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists. • Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity. • Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO. • Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies. • Willingness to travel occasionally. What We Offer • Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus. • Remote flexibility. • A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust. • Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth. • Regular team events and company celebrations.
